comment: Exact uutils test IDs (module::function) excluded from Gate 3. One entry per test; module-wide exclusions are rejected by dev/compat/check_exclusions.py, which also fixes the category list. Excluded tests still count in the totals as `excluded`.

tests.reason: The test also runs `-h`, a help alias uutils adds; GNU basename has no -h (it is an invalid option) and XSH follows GNU. --help is covered by core/tests/test-basename.xsh.
The test also runs `-V`, a version alias uutils adds; GNU basename has only --version and XSH follows GNU. --version is covered by core/tests/test-basename.xsh.

Runs `tee -h` expecting the --help text; GNU tee's short options are only -a, -i and -p (src/tee.c getopt string "aip"), so -h is a uutils extension and XSH follows GNU. --help is covered by core/tests/test-tee.xsh.
uutils quotes an argument containing an apostrophe as "'1" (double quotes); GNU quote() prints '\'1' (verified on GNU coreutils 9.4: `sleep "'1"`), and XSH follows GNU via gnu.quote_value.
